description: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) publishes a searchable list of all its projects, with a Project Summary Document (PSD) for each investment project and a TC PSD for grant-funded technical assistance above EUR 75,000 that is not tied to specific Bank financing. The projects page states that the EBRD has invested over EUR 222 billion in more than 7,883 projects across three continents, with 640 projects in 2025. Coverage: EBRD projects in the economies where the Bank invests, from 1991; filters on the page cover project type (investment or technical cooperation), status, location, sector and whether documents are attached. Format and access: the project list is browsed on the web page; a download button creates a CSV file of all projects, regardless of the filters applied, and a separate projects overview workbook for 1991-2025 is offered as XLSX (about 0.6 MB, last modified May 2026). PSDs give a factual summary of each project and contact details for the project company. Free, no registration. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): EBRD terms and conditions: personal, non-commercial use, no redistribution or derivative works. Caveats: the CSV export and the workbook were not opened, so their columns were not checked; energy, transport, water and municipal infrastructure projects sit among financial-sector and corporate ones and must be filtered by sector. Simulation uses: a list of financed infrastructure projects by location and sector, as input to investment pipeline and capacity planning studies in Central and Eastern Europe, Central Asia, the Middle East and North Africa. Related records: the European Investment Bank financed projects data (data-eib-financed-projects-and-open-data) covers EIB lending in the same way.
